Scorer automatically sends counts of app: Scorer automatically sends counts of app openings and normal closes, new and loaded careers, completed training and matches, goals and save/load failures to stats.clemir.com to understand game usage. No player name, career file or device identifier is included in these counts. Our collector stores combined daily totals for 90 days; unsent counts expire after 7 days. Cloudflare handles the HTTPS connection and IP address. Public name sharing is separate and optional. There is no usage switch in this version. Continue acknowledges this notice; it is not consent to publish your name.
